## What this changes

Explain the specific observed problem or improvement. Link a related issue.

## Evidence

- [ ] Source revision and affected files identified
- [ ] Focused tests run with commands and results provided (or explicitly explain why tests were not run)
- [ ] New regression check corresponds to a demonstrated defect, rather than an invented scenario
- [ ] No copyrighted songs/lyrics, credentials, personal identifiers, private datasets, or proprietary binary artifacts included
- [ ] Third-party licenses and attribution preserved
- [ ] Claims about Android builds, FLAC decoding and singing-alignment performance match what tests actually exercised

## Test output and limitations

Paste sanitized commands, exit codes and first failure. If this PR adds synthetic media, identify how it was generated and its redistribution rights.

## Notes for maintainers

Describe potential compatibility or performance regressions. Keep review limited to affected functionality; the private development repository and owner's devices are not public test targets.
